question: When difference between compound and simple interest for three years is ₹217 at 10% interest per annum, the principal is ₹______
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective Simple Interest (SI) rate for 3 years at 10% = 3 × 10% = 30%

Effective Compound Interest (CI) rate for 3 years at 10% = 33.1%

Difference in effective rates = 33.1% − 30% = 3.1%

Given difference = ₹217 ⇒ 3.1% of P = 217

⇒ P = (217 ÷ 3.1) × 100 = ₹7000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹7000.**
